events.title: HF Features Broken
events.description: Omniscient has steadily made fixes to the newly upgraded forum this week. For starters, he squashed a bug with the IP login history feature that has been occurring since May but had gone unnoticed. You can read more about it in his thread here. He also disabled the feature where group owners were receiving email notifications every time a new member applied for a group via User CP. The last fix we'll cover is the YouTube MyCode tag used for embedding videos in posts, which is now fully functional.

events.title: New Navigation Menu
events.description: If you have been browsing Hack Forums this week, you will notice that there is a new navigation menu at the very top of the page. This was added after the removal of Omniscient's previous hamburger menu experiment. This new menu is another step toward his goal of making the forum mobile-friendly.

events.title: Wiki Link Added to Navigation Menu
events.description: A link to the official Hack Forums Wiki has been added to the navigation menu under the Help category. This is the first time since Omniscient's HF Writers Group and Wiki DELETED thread that members receive any additional news on the Writers group. With the link being added to the navigation menu, we assume that the Writers group will make a comeback.
